headline: Maye's three second-half touchdowns rally Patriots past Miami
takeaway: Down 13–3 at halftime, Drake Maye threw two touchdown passes and ran for a third as New England scored 21 straight points. The Patriots are 5–3 and 3–0 in the AFC East.

sections.label: 1st quarter
sections.text: Andy Borregales opened the scoring with a 34-yard field goal. Jacob Rodriguez then forced an Efton Chism III fumble that Miami recovered at the New England 19, and Zane Gonzalez's 31-yard field goal tied it 3–3.

sections.label: 2nd quarter
sections.text: Gonzalez's 52-yarder bounced in off the upright for a 6–3 Miami lead. Borregales missed a 40-yard try wide right with 2:24 left, and Miami answered with an 11-play, 70-yard drive capped by Malik Willis's 1-yard touchdown pass to Malik Washington with eight seconds left. Hunter Henry left with a foot injury.

sections.label: 3rd quarter
sections.text: Maye hit Kyle Williams for a 43-yard touchdown that was ruled incomplete until Mike Vrabel's challenge overturned it, making it 13–10. Maye then scored on a 2-yard run off a fake pitch on third-and-goal with 59 seconds left. He went 7-of-7 for 96 yards in the quarter.

sections.label: 4th quarter
sections.text: Kevin Byard's first interception as a Patriot set up Maye's 48-yard touchdown to DeMario Douglas for a 24–13 lead with 12:39 left. Willis found Kevin Coleman Jr. for a 35-yard score with 2:04 left, but the two-point try failed, Rhamondre Stevenson recovered the onside kick, and his 5-yard run on third-and-5 ran out the clock.

performers.name: Drake Maye
performers.note: Had 53 passing yards at halftime, then went 9-of-10 for 146 yards after it; his fifth straight game with at least three touchdowns.

performers.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
performers.note: Recovered the onside kick and picked up the clinching first down.

performers.name: DeMario Douglas
performers.note: Caught every target, including the 48-yard catch-and-run that made it a two-score game.

oppLine: Malik Willis was 21-of-32 for 211 yards and two touchdowns with an interception and was sacked five times; Ollie Gordon ran for 69 yards on 19 carries.
